name: MenuForge

name: Orion-Net
tagline: Decentralized encrypted chat system with ephemeral rooms & hub routing
description: Decentralized, encrypted chat system featuring ephemeral memory-only room allocations, hub-based peer-to-peer message routing, and zero data persistence on disk. Engineered for resilience and strict privacy without intermediary telemetry.

features: End-to-end encrypted packet transmission with ephemeral key rotation
Memory-only room states destroyed upon node termination
Hub-and-spoke mesh fallback routing for low-latency dispatch
Zero telemetry, zero user tracking, and zero log serialization
